messages.speaker: Longado
messages.text: I woke up in a painting... Is this 水墨? It feels soft and a little lonely.

messages.speaker: Longado
messages.text: What is your name? I want to remember the first human I met.

messages.speaker: Longado
messages.text:
Mark! Now I know your name.

My name is Longado.

You do not have a Chinese name yet, so I want to give you one: 马克.

- 马 sounds like “Ma” in Mark. It means horse in English.
- 克 sounds like the end of “Mark.” It can mean to overcome or be capable.

So 马克 sounds close to your name, and it feels strong and steady. I think it fits you.

I do not know any Chinese words yet, but I am ready to learn with you. If you want, teach me one word next.
